title: BTS Make Argentina Debut at Estadio Único, La Plata
detail: BTS played their first-ever Argentina show, the first of three nights at Estadio Único Diego Armando Maradona. The 23-song set opened with 'Hooligan', included surprises 'Hold Me Tight' and 'Dionysus', and the members spoke Spanish; fans wore Argentina No. 10 jerseys. Spotify data cited by La Nación puts BTS's Argentine streams at 250.6M (Oct 2025–Sep 2026), moving the country from 14th to 8th among their top listening markets.
